HEIC / HEIF conversion uses unmodified heic-to 1.6.7 by Hopper Gee, licensed
under LGPL-3.0. Its decoder includes libheif. The license is provided beside
this notice as heic-to-LICENSE.txt.

Package and corresponding source:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/heic-to/v/1.6.7
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to

The decoder is bundled separately in the photo conversion worker. It runs on
this device; this conversion does not send the photo to an external service.
